title: Store Backend - Enterprise E-Commerce Platform
tech: .NET 9 - C# 13 - LanguageExt - MassTransit - SignalR - Entity Framework Core 9 - Stripe - SendGrid
desc: A modern e-commerce backend built with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Functional Programming, and Event-Driven Architecture. Features modular monolith architecture with 7 bounded contexts, real-time notifications, and complete e-commerce workflows.

gallery.title: Modular Monolith Architecture
gallery.description: 7 independent business modules: Identity, Product, Basket, Inventory, Order, Payment, and Shipment with strict bounded contexts

gallery.title: Functional Programming with Railway-Oriented Programming
gallery.description: Elegant error handling using Fin<T> monads, IO effects, and composable data access patterns with LanguageExt

gallery.title: Domain Monad DB Pattern
gallery.description: Custom functional data access layer using IO monad for database operations with automatic transaction management

gallery.title: Monad DB Bindings
gallery.description: Implementation details showing Monad DB bindings

gallery.title: Monadic Caching Strategy
gallery.description: Distributed caching implementation using customized Db Monad for side-effect management

gallery.title: Generic Repository Pattern
gallery.description: Generic repository implementation using Db Monad for type-safe, composable data access with pagination support

features: Domain-Driven Design with modular monolith architecture and bounded contexts
Functional Programming paradigm using LanguageExt throughout the codebase
Railway-Oriented Programming with Fin<T> for explicit error handling
Event-Driven Architecture using MassTransit for integration events
Real-time notifications via SignalR (payment, orders, shipment tracking, delivery)
CQRS pattern with MediatR for command/query separation
Custom Domain Monad DB pattern for composable database operations
IO monad for side-effect management and referential transparency
Option Type for null safety eliminating NullReferenceException
7 business modules: Identity, Product, Basket, Inventory, Order, Payment, Shipment
Stripe payment integration with webhook handling and idempotent processing
JWT authentication with role and permission-based authorization
Email system with SendGrid integration and HTML templates
Dynamic shipping cost calculation (free shipping over $29.50)
Multi-variant product support with dynamic inventory management
Automatic tracking code generation for shipments
Entity Framework Core 9 with code-first migrations

functionalProgrammingHighlights.description: All business operations return Fin<T> for explicit success/failure handling. Errors propagate automatically without exceptions.
functionalProgrammingHighlights.example: from cart in GetCart() from order in CreateOrder(cart) select order - Composable error handling

functionalProgrammingHighlights.description: Database operations, file uploads, and external API calls wrapped in IO<T> for referential transparency
functionalProgrammingHighlights.example: IO<Unit> for database saves ensures testability and pure functions

functionalProgrammingHighlights.description: Custom functional data access layer with GetEntity, GetEntities, GetUpdateEntity returning IO monads
functionalProgrammingHighlights.example: Composable LINQ expressions that execute lazily with automatic transaction management

functionalProgrammingHighlights.description: Replaces null references with explicit Option<T> types preventing NullReferenceException at compile time
functionalProgrammingHighlights.example: Optional(user) returns Some(user) or None instead of null

functionalProgrammingHighlights.description: Captures exceptions as values using Try<T> for safer error handling
Map, Bind, Traverse, Fold for data transformations without mutation
functionalProgrammingHighlights.example: Traverse validates collections, Apply combines multiple validations

functionalProgrammingHighlights.description: All entities use C# records for structural equality and immutability ensuring thread-safety
functionalProgrammingHighlights.example: record Order with { Status = OrderStatus.Paid } - No mutation

dddPatterns.description: Root entities that enforce invariants and encapsulate business logic
dddPatterns.example: Order aggregate manages OrderItems, validates state transitions, and raises domain events

dddPatterns.description: Immutable objects defined by their attributes (Money, Email, Address)
dddPatterns.example: Money.FromDecimal(100) ensures non-negative values, Email.From(string) validates format

dddPatterns.description: Events raised by aggregates to signal important state changes
Functional repositories using Db Monad pattern for composable queries
dddPatterns.example: from order in GetEntity() from updated in UpdateEntity() select updated

dddPatterns.description: 7 independent modules with clear boundaries communicating via integration events
dddPatterns.example: Payment module publishes PaymentFulfilledEvent consumed by Order and Shipment modules

moduleDescriptions.responsibility: User management, authentication, JWT tokens, roles and permissions
Product catalog, variants (color, size), reviews, and subscriptions
Shopping cart, line items, coupons, and shipping cost calculation
Stock management, warehouse operations, and inventory tracking
Order processing, lifecycle management, and order status tracking
Stripe payment processing, payment intents, and webhook handling
Shipping management, tracking codes, and delivery notifications

eventFlowExample: 4. Payment module creates Stripe payment intent
6. Order marked as paid → Real-time notification sent via SignalR
8. Email sent with tracking code via SendGrid
techHighlights: .NET 9 with C# 13 latest language features
LanguageExt library for functional programming (Fin<T>, Option<T>, IO<T>, Try<T>)
MassTransit for distributed messaging with RabbitMQ
SignalR with Redis backplane for real-time horizontal scaling
Entity Framework Core 9 with code-first migrations
MediatR for CQRS pattern implementation
Stripe API for payment processing with webhook security
SendGrid for email delivery with HTML templates
Twilio for SMS notifications
Cloudinary for image storage and optimization
SQL Server for relational data persistence
JWT authentication with refresh tokens
xUnit and Testcontainers for testing
OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation

title: Store Frontend - Modern React E-Commerce Client
tech: Next.js 16 - React 19 - TypeScript - Redux Toolkit (RTK Query) - SignalR - Tailwind CSS - Framer Motion - Stripe Elements
desc: E-commerce frontend application built with Next.js App Router and Feature-Sliced Design. optimized for performance and real-time user experiences with WebSocket integration.

gallery.title: Interactive Dashboard
gallery.description: Real-time admin dashboard with ApexCharts visualizations for sales, revenue, and order analytics

gallery.title: Atomic Component Design
gallery.description: Highly reusable UI components organized by atoms, molecules, and organisms for consistent design system

gallery.title: Secure Payment Integration
gallery.description: Seamless checkout experience using Stripe React Elements with real-time status updates via SignalR

gallery.title: Real-Time WebSocket Updates
gallery.description: Instant notifications for order status changes, stock alerts, and delivery tracking using SignalR Hub connection

features: Next.js 15 App Router with Server & Client Component separation
Feature-Based Architecture (features/auth, features/product, etc.) for maintainability
State Management with Redux Toolkit and persistence via redux-persist
Data Fetching & Caching with RTK Query (automatic tag invalidation)
Real-time bidirectional communication using Microsoft SignalR
Atomic Design Pattern (Atoms, Molecules, Organisms, Templates)
Form Management with React Hook Form and Zod schema validation
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with HOCs (WithAuth, WithRole, WithPermission)
Stripe Payment Elements integration for secure transactions
Dynamic dashboards with ApexCharts for data visualization
Internationalization (i18n) support infrastructure
Optimistic UI updates for immediate user feedback
Smooth animations with Framer Motion for page transitions and micro-interactions
Custom UI component library built on Radix UI primitives

frontendPatterns.description: Codebase organized by business domains (features/) rather than technical layers, with strict public APIs for each feature.
frontendPatterns.example: features/cart/ exports only what other modules need via index.ts

frontendPatterns.description: reusable logic wrappers for authentication and authorization logic.
Code splitting for API definition using injectEndpoints to keep the base API clean and features independent.
Strict separation of UI components into Atoms (Inputs), Molecules (SearchBars), and Organisms (ProductCards).
Separation of view logic from UI components using custom hooks.
frontendPatterns.example: useProductFilters() manages URL search params and local state sync

stateManagement.description: Global state for Shopping Cart, User Session, and UI preferences
stateManagement.persistence: localStorage via redux-persist with SSR reconciliation

stateManagement.description: Server state management, caching, and automatic refetching on cache invalidation
Search filters, pagination, and sorting persisted in URL coordinates

moduleDescriptions.responsibility: Login/Register forms, password reset flows, and JWT token management
Category navigation, dynamic tab panels (Men/Women/Kids), and carousels
Product grids, details views, filtering logic, and image galleries
Shopping cart management, item quantity updates, and price calculations
Order history, detailing, and status tracking
SignalR connection management and toast notification display
Stripe Elements wrapper and payment intent handling

techHighlights: Next.js 16 with Turbopack for rapid development
React 19 utilizing newest hooks and concurrent features
TypeScript strict mode for type safety
Tailwind CSS with 'cn' utility for conditional styling
SignalR Client with automatic reconnection policies
Radix UI for accessible headless UI primitives
Zod schema validation for robust form handling
ApexCharts for responsive data visualization
ESLint + Prettier configuration for code quality
